FAQ

Questions, answered.

Estimates, insurance, timing, warranty and what to do after an accident.

About the shop

What services do you offer?

Cosmetic and structural vehicle repair, bumper repair, paint repair, paintless dent removal, windshield and glass replacement, and vehicle diagnostics and calibration.

How long will my repair take?

It depends on the damage, the repairs needed and parts availability. We give you an estimated timeline after inspecting the vehicle, and we provide repair updates while your vehicle is at our facility.

How much will my repair cost?

Cost depends on the extent of the damage, the parts and materials needed, and the labor required. Your estimate is free, and we always provide transparent pricing information.

Do you warranty your repairs?

Our workmanship is warranted for as long as you own the vehicle. Parts carry the manufacturer’s warranty. If something isn’t right with our repair, bring it back and we’ll make it right.

What are your hours?

Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Where are you located?

904 State Route 21, Palmyra, NY 14522. Get directions.

After an accident & insurance

What should I do right after a collision?

Get to safety and call 911 if anyone is hurt. Exchange information, photograph the scene and every vehicle, and notify your insurer. In New York, a crash with injury, death, or property damage over $1,000 must be reported to the DMV on form MV-104 within 10 days. Then call us for the next step.

Do I have to use the shop my insurance company suggests?

No. New York law gives you the right to choose where your vehicle is repaired. Your insurer can recommend a shop, but the choice is yours.

Can you help with my insurance claim?

Yes. We work with all major insurance companies. We communicate with your provider and make sure the repair is documented according to their guidelines. Coverage decisions are between you and your insurer, and we keep you informed.

What if more damage is found after the repair starts?

It’s common. Removing damaged parts often reveals damage behind them. It gets documented, sent to your insurer for approval if a claim is involved, and discussed with you before any extra work.

How do I get an estimate?

Estimates are free with no obligation. Start online with photos, call, or stop by. Photo estimates are preliminary; the final estimate follows an in-person inspection.

My car isn’t drivable. What now?

Call us at (315) 584-1944 and tell us where the vehicle is. Many policies include towing coverage, so check yours too. We’ll talk through how to get the vehicle here.

How does a rental car work during my repair?

Rental coverage depends on your policy or the at-fault driver’s insurer. Ask your adjuster what your claim includes. We keep you and the insurer updated so the rental lines up with the repair.
